messages:
natalie: Noticed perf bump after kernel-tuning PR. Short requests suffering. p95 decode +11%.
cheng: Looking at host profiles: tokenize CPU up, writev syscall increase.
vijay: Any change to tokenization?
natalie: We moved tokenizer to per-request instances to avoid token-state leaks. Removed pool. Adds ~1ms.
ops-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T03:00:00Z - kernel-tuning staged to 40%
cheng: Flame snippet: request.parse 0.7ms, token.single 1.1ms, kernel.pick 0.8ms (flip), kv.lookup 0.5ms (eviction +15%), sidecar.writev 0.6ms (many tiny writes)
vijay: microbatcher heuristics also shrunk batch sizes -> more kernel switches
natalie: Proposal: reintroduce small tokenizer pool, pin kernel for seq <= 56, coalesce sidecar writes. I'll coordinate canary.
cheng: I'll run canary with kernel pin and report back.
ops-bot: perf job queued run=6112231000
